summary: Route generated artifacts to integration workstream

delivery.outcome: Every generated file recorded by the VOL-1 artifact registry has an explicit integration owner, enabling separately budgeted cleanup tickets.
nonGoals: Delete generated files or rewrite Git history
Transfer ownership of governance carriers or project/readme.sh
Change runtime behavior, dependencies, documentation or CI

architecture.decision: Route only the exact generated groups enumerated by config/artifact-registry.json to integration ownership.
architecture.rollback: Revert the protected merge to restore the prior workstream registry.

validation.evidence: managed gates and protected validator receipt
